question:
Select the option which is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

PRODUCT : CDOPRTU :: CONFUSE : CEFNOSU :: QUALITY : ?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] Logic : Rearranged the letters within the word in ascending order. So, • PRODUCT : CDOPRTU
